BrochureContent.Content:
No. 50 Shandon Park is an exceptional period redbrick end-of-terrace residence that has been extensively renovated and upgraded to an exacting standard while carefully retaining many of its original features and charm. Behind the attractive redbrick façade, with its beautiful sash windows and striking stained-glass front door, lies a superbly presented family home that has been thoughtfully redesigned and renovated to suit modern family living while preserving its period character. The property underwent a comprehensive refurbishment including a full rewire and replumb in 2017 and was further enhanced with the addition of a substantial rear extension. Designed with modern family living in mind, this impressive space benefits from underfloor heating, large rooflights, high-level glazing and bi-fold doors that flood the interior with natural light while creating a seamless connection to the rear garden. A gas boiler was also installed in 2017.

The property further benefits from bespoke joinery throughout and carefully preserved original features including fireplaces, original floorboards and decorative ceiling coving. The result is a beautifully balanced home where period character and contemporary design sit effortlessly side by side.

Upon entering through the striking stained-glass front door, one is welcomed by a bright and spacious entrance hall featuring herringbone flooring, ceiling coving, recessed lighting, under-stairs storage and a guest WC. To the front of the property lies an elegant and generously proportioned reception room overlooking the front garden. As part of the renovation, this room was reconfigured and enlarged to create a more spacious and versatile living area than is typically found in similar homes. The room features a wood-burning stove, bespoke fitted shelving and cabinetry, a built-in workstation, ceiling coving and a large sash window that fills the room with natural light.

To the rear, the property opens into a magnificent open-plan kitchen, dining and living space, extended in 2017 to create an exceptional family hub. Finished with herringbone flooring throughout, this impressive room enjoys excellent ceiling height and is flooded with natural light from three large rooflights, high-level glazing and full-width bi-fold doors. The bespoke kitchen is fitted with sleek contemporary cabinetry, stone worktops, a large central island incorporating additional storage and a sink unit, and an excellent range of integrated appliances. A bespoke media unit and extensive fitted storage further enhance this outstanding living space.

The rear garden is a particular feature of the property, offering a wonderfully private and mature outdoor space that is not directly overlooked. Laid out with a generous lawn, paved patio and attractive planted borders, it provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining, entertaining and family enjoyment. To the rear stands a substantial detached garage benefiting from electricity and plumbing for a dryer. The garage provides excellent storage and, importantly, offers valuable rear vehicular access. This allows for secure off-street parking and also offers excellent potential for the installation of an EV charging point.

Upstairs, the landing features recessed lighting, a skylight and access to the floored attic via a Stira staircase. Bedroom One is a spacious double room overlooking the rear garden and enjoys beautiful original timber flooring, built-in wardrobes, an original fireplace and a lovely leafy outlook. Bedroom Two is another generous double bedroom retaining its original floorboards and fireplace and benefiting from built-in wardrobes. Bedroom Three is a bright single bedroom positioned to the front of the property and features original timber flooring and a sash window. Completing the accommodation is a family bathroom fitted with a bath and overhead shower, WC and wash hand basin, and finished with tiled walls and flooring.

Shandon Park enjoys an enviable position in the heart of Phibsborough, one of Dublin's most sought-after residential locations. Residents are within walking distance of an excellent selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and local amenities, while nearby Stoneybatter and the Phoenix Park offer an abundance of recreational and leisure opportunities.

Number 50 holds an exceptional position on Shandon Park. Surrounded by greenspace, it is situated in front of a small park with direct access to the Royal Canal and opposite Shandon Pitch and Putt Club. Mount Bernard Park, with its extensive sport facilities and playground, is a short stroll from the front door.

The area is exceptionally well connected with numerous Dublin Bus routes, the Luas and the Royal Canal Greenway all within easy reach. The Greenway provides a scenic route linking the area to the IFSC, Docklands, Grand Canal and the wider city cycling network. In addition, the M50, M1 and Dublin Airport are all easily accessible, making this an exceptionally convenient location for commuters.

Combining exceptional modern upgrades, striking contemporary living spaces, rare rear vehicular access and beautiful period character, No. 50 Shandon Park represents a rare opportunity to acquire a turnkey family home in one of Dublin 7's most desirable and well-established residential neighbourhoods.

Magnificent open-plan kitchen, dining and living space featuring herringbone flooring, bespoke fitted cabinetry, stone worktops, a large central island, integrated appliances, bespoke media unit and extensive storage. Three rooflights and bi-fold doors flood the room with natural light and provide direct access to the rear garden.

Landing - 2.80m x 1.80m

Bedroom One - 3.60m x 3.80m
Spacious rear-facing double bedroom featuring original timber flooring, built-in wardrobes, an original fireplace and a pleasant outlook over the rear garden.

Bedroom Two - 3.30m x 3.20m
Generous front-facing double bedroom featuring original timber flooring, built-in wardrobes, an original fireplace and a sash window.

Bedroom Three - 2.20m x 2.40m
Bright single bedroom featuring original timber flooring and a sash window.

Bathroom Room - 1.70m x 1.80m
Family bathroom fitted with a bath and overhead shower, WC and wash hand basin, finished with tiled flooring, tiled walls and recessed lighting.

Garage - 4.80m x 5.80m
Substantial detached garage positioned to the rear of the garden, benefiting from electricity supply and plumbing for a tumble dryer. The garage provides excellent storage and valuable rear vehicular access, offering secure off-street parking and potential for the installation of an EV charging point.
